experiment: Living pages (gbrain wave 4b W9): build decision by the read/write break-even
owner_data: none. The owner declined to supply production-brain counts, so queries A and B were never run and r_obs is unknown.
reason: The build threshold is 1,387 reads per changed page-day. Nothing known about a personal brain's read rate comes close: a personal brain's reads are made by its owner and the owner's agents, and every changed page-day would need well over a thousand reads of that content for a reviewed refresh to pay back. Without review cost the threshold would still be 23.2 (8.2 at the cheapest measured refresh), but propose mode always carries review.
reopen_condition: Reopen if aggregate telemetry from a hosted brain shows r_obs >= the threshold (1,387 reads per changed page-day at the preregistered pricing), measured with the preregistration's queries A and B or their hosted equivalents.
decided_by: GBRA-108 (GBrain Minder) on 2026-10-17, under the crew rule not to request production-brain data
